title: dep-scan mcp diff_scans input
description: The arguments the diff_scans tool of `depscan mcp` accepts: the earlier and the later of two scan directories. The server validates the arguments against this schema, so an unknown argument is a tool error rather than a silently ignored one.

old_scan_dir.description: The earlier scan directory, as an absolute path. The tool refuses a path that does not resolve, with os.path.realpath, inside a root the server was started with.

new_scan_dir.description: The later scan directory, as an absolute path, subject to the same root rule as old_scan_dir.
